versions.changelog:
- Expanded triggers to include more ways users may imply or request prior experience, both in English and Chinese.
- Clarified that "experience" context is supported; removed references to "memory" context until future rollout.
- Changed guidance to proactively recall prior experience before analyzing or implementing a task, not just when explicitly requested.
- Updated workflow and approval instructions to emphasize front-loaded recall and improved query construction from user input.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Initial beta release of the alibabacloud-agentloop-experience skill.
- Enables recall of prior Alibaba Cloud AgentLoop experience using the bundled SearchContext CLI.
- Supports explicit user approval for transmitting queries to Recall endpoints.
- Includes CLI instructions, configuration via recall.env, and detailed query practices.
- Handles common edge cases (e.g., missing config, outbound confirmation, API errors).
- Intended for environments with Node.js 18+ and network access to configured endpoints.
